alt.en: A long row of gray blocks with an indigo newest block floats at the center. A dashed orange line with packets runs to it from a teal database on the left, and a dotted violet line runs to it from a standing page with a violet ring on the right.
alt.zh: 画面中央是一排灰色方块，最新一块为靛蓝色，悬在末端。左侧青绿色数据库以带数据包的橙色虚线连向它，右侧带紫色圆环的直立文档以紫色点线连向它。

caption.en: Illustration: an agent-synthesized database component and a correctness specification both feed a record of which component was deployed, as in the design the authors describe. It does not depict a tested deployment, and it does not show that the firewalls preserve results as described.
caption.zh: 示意图：按作者描述的设计，智能体生成的数据库组件与正确性规范共同汇入一份记录，标明部署的是哪个组件。图中并非经过测试的实际部署，也不表明这些防火墙能如所述保持结果正确。
